show.sharing_text: हेलो! मैंने कुकू एफएम पर इस शो को सुना और मेरे ख्‍याल से आपको भी पसंद आएगा
show.sharing_text_v2:
हेलो! मैंने Kuku FM (Android)  पर यह शो सुना और मुझे यकीन है कि आपको भी यह जरूर पसंद आएगा। 
https://links.kukufm.com/UTtpsE
show.description: Kabir, a fearless undercover operative known by his codename Agent Vajra, lives a double life defined by loyalty and sacrifice. When the President’s daughter is attacked by ruthless goons, Kabir steps in without hesitation, saving her in a high-risk rescue that exposes a larger conspiracy against the nation. At the same time, he is shattered by his wife’s betrayal—but even after discovering her deception, he refuses to let personal pain cloud his duty. When she is kidnapped by a terrorist from a hostile foreign country, Kabir risks everything to rescue her, proving that his sense of honor rises above heartbreak. In a gripping climax, he thwarts an assassination attempt on the President, dismantles the terror network, and emerges as a true patriot who places his country above all, earning the title of a selfless national hero.
